3:133.text: And hasten to forgiveness from your Lord and a garden
as wide as the heavens and earth, prepared for the righteous

3:134.text: during ease and hardship and who restrain anger and who pardon the people - and Allāh loves the doers of good;

3:135.text: And those who, when they commit an immorality or wrong themselves
, remember Allāh and seek forgiveness for their sins - and who can forgive sins except Allāh? - and
do not persist in what they have done while they know.
